options.text: Read the section, then dissolve sugar in warm water and in cool water and note which dissolves faster while thinking about what he sees.
Skip the book and only stir sugar in water with no reading.
Take the book outdoors and reread the same page, because reading outside is better science learning than a kitchen test.
Memorise every bold word in the section and stop there.

stem:
Arjun has finished reading a short section about dissolving. He wants a plan that matches this chapter's view of learning science.

Which plan best matches that view?

teacher.key_rationale: Learning science should move beyond only reading into observing, doing, and careful thinking. Dissolving sugar in two conditions checks an idea from the book; skipping the book, only reading outdoors, or memorising alone miss that view.
